company.name: eBrandValue
company.shortDescription: eBrandValue helps marketers interrogate social data to increase the value of a brand.
company.description: eBrandValue launched in 2012 with the mission of helping marketers interrogate social data to increase the value of a brand. Founders Tolga and Ayse Akçura bring over forty years of marketing and financial insights, gathered from positions at some of the world’s most prestigious firms and institutions. The Akçuras are backed by a robust team of PhDs, developers, and analysts that sift through many terabytes of data to ensure the value of their client’s brands keeps rising.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that integrates social data with sales and marketing data to provide real-time brand performance metrics and predictive analytics.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 84 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 77 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
